title: Spinach Lasagna Roll Ups
description: This spinach lasagna roll-ups recipe is easy to make. They're delicious filled with spinach, ricotta, and mozzarella and covered with marinara sauce.
ingredients: 1 (10 ounce) package frozen chopped spinach, thawed and drained
0.25 cup grated Parmesan cheese, or to taste

steps.text: Preheat the oven to 350 degrees F (175 degrees C).

Bring a large pot of lightly salted water to a boil. Cook lasagna noodles in boiling water, stirring occasionally, until tender yet firm to the bite, about 8 minutes. Drain; lay noodles flat onto a flat surface.

Heat olive oil in a small skillet over medium heat. Add garlic; cook and stir until fragrant, about 2 minutes. Transfer garlic to a large bowl. Add spinach, ricotta cheese, mozzarella cheese, and salt to the bowl; stir until evenly combined.

Spread a heaping 1/4 cup spinach mixture into middle of each lasagna noodle. Roll noodles firmly around filling; arrange in a baking dish. Pour spaghetti sauce over rolls. Cover dish with aluminum foil.
Bake in the preheated oven for 30 minutes. Remove foil; continue baking 5 minutes more. Sprinkle Parmesan cheese over rolls to serve.

video.description: Forget those long layering instructions for assembling your favorite lasagna dish. After you’ve boiled your noodles, whip up a quick ricotta and mozzarella spread mixed with spinach. Roll everything together, top with sauce and bake! It’s really that easy to enjoy the cheesy Italian flavors you love . . . makes a great weeknight meal the entire family will be happy to eat!
